physical_relative_pose_ground_truth: Independent original TUM motion-capture camera poses; acquired from pinned public mirror, not independently verified against official archive
ground_truth_format: timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw; world-from-camera; metres; xyzw quaternion

depth_calibration.frame: registered optical camera x-right y-down z-forward
depth_calibration.limitations: Published FR1 RGB intrinsics used as an explicit pinhole model for pre-registered depth; no Brown-Conrady pixel undistortion is performed, and native infrared extrinsics/vehicle calibration are unavailable. Source distortion coefficients are retained as provenance, not applied to images or asserted correct after registration.

depth_manifest_reference.relationship: Previously evaluated depth inputs; entire paired sequence is viewed development, despite newly acquired RGB

selection_policy: Fixed original depth indices 100..135 inclusive. Paired each depth timestamp with the nearest recorded RGB timestamp (earlier RGB index resolves exact ties), maximum absolute clock gap 0.02 seconds. All 36 depth observations are retained, including repeated RGB acquisitions; their exact repeated RGB timestamps must cause explicit operational rejection without clock renewal. No interpolation or synthetic image is provided. Depth frames/reference poses were previously viewed in submap trials; this entire paired interval is viewed development, not a new held-out evaluation.

association_audit.association_rule: nearest RGB timestamp, earlier index on exact tie; no resampling or interpolation
